user.title: ista Calista (Spain)
user.description: Enter the e-mail and password you use in the ista tenant portal ({url}).

data_description.username: E-mail of your ista Calista tenant account.
data_description.password: Password of your ista Calista account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ista Calista
reauth_confirm.description: ista rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.action_required: The ista portal is asking for an action (change the password, accept the terms…). Log in at oficina.ista.es, complete it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ista portal.
error.unsupported: The ista portal answered in an unexpected format.

abort.wrong_account: Use the same account. To add another account, add the integration again.

data_description.update_interval_hours: Hours between two reads of the portal (1–24). ista publishes radio readings once a day, a few days late.
data_description.import_statistics: Adds each daily reading to the long-term statistics on its real date, so the consumption appears on the right day and the water meters can be used in the Energy dashboard.
data_description.history_days: Days of history to import the first time (0–1095).
data_description.stale_days: A meter is reported as having no data when its last reading is older than this (2–60). ista publishes readings about 3 days late and some days are missing.

action_required.message: The ista portal is asking for an action before logging in. Log in at oficina.ista.es and complete it.

portal_changed.title: The ista portal has changed
portal_changed.description:
The integration could not interpret the ista Calista portal for {account}:

`{error}`

Its entities stay unavailable until the portal answers as expected. Check whether there is a new version of the integration in HACS or [report it]({url}).

action_required.title: ista needs you to complete an action on its website
action_required.description: To keep reading {account}, log in at [oficina.ista.es]({url}) and complete what the portal asks for (change the password, accept the terms…). Then re-authenticate the integration from **Settings → Devices & services**.

stale_meters.title: ista meters without recent readings
stale_meters.description:
These meters of {account} have not had a reading for more than {days} days: **{meters}**.

It is usually a battery or radio problem in the meter. If it persists, contact ista. This warning disappears by itself when readings arrive again.
